subject: [PATCH v2 3/3] mm/memory: add anonymous mTHP folios to the deferred split list

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch adds anonymous mTHP (huge page) folios to the deferred split list in the Linux kernel's memory management code. This allows for underused splitting of huge pages, which can help reclaim unused parts of large memory allocations when the system is under memory pressure. The patch addresses a problem where fully mapped huge pages that are mostly zero-filled do not get split by the deferred split shrinker, leading to memory regressions. The solution involves mirroring the behavior for PMD-sized folios and adding a check to minimize overhead on common fault paths.
